title: Ryan: approve the operator deploys and PyPI publishing
description:
**Reworked 2026-11-04:** Ryan reversed the architecture. No new AWS account and no central service; see docs/notifications-plan.md in AnthusAI/Caducus.

**Milestone:** M1, first slice

**Goal.** What Ryan must still do for the first slice. No account, no SES request, no verification mail, no SNS click.

**Build.**
1. Say yes to these writes in papyrus-production, each shown first as a change set: stack `papyrus-newsletter-sending-operators` (identity, DNS records under notify.anth.us); change set on `papyrus-monitoring` (listener, queues, table, Lambdas, heartbeat, last-resort alarms; IAM stated in a plain table).
2. Say which mailbox operator mail goes to. Default: the parameter `/papyrus/shipped/knowledge-run/alarm-email`, already used by the stack, whose subscription to `papyrus-monitoring-alarms` is confirmed. Nothing to do if that is right. Separately, that topic also shows one subscription stuck at PendingConfirmation: click it or tell me to remove it.
3. PyPI, for `caducus`: confirm the project on PyPI is ours (it holds only 0.1.0), then add a trusted publisher for AnthusAI/Caducus, workflow `release.yml`. Repo secrets show no `PYPI_API_TOKEN`, and the last release run failed. Trusted publishing stores no key, which suits the rule; a token is the fallback. Until it is done the zip can pin a Git tag.
4. Choose the IAM Identity Center permission set the alarm links should open with (a read-only one if there is one). Its name and the portal address go in the SSM parameter `/papyrus/monitoring/triage`, written by an agent after you say which.

**Acceptance.**
Recorded yes for each change set; `pip install caducus==<new>` works, or the Git-tag fallback is chosen.
